annotation.evidence_span: detects multiple different errors, it MAY choose to report any one of those errors
annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint, upon detecting multiple errors, can select and report only one of them, discarding the others.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint, upon detecting multiple errors, can report any combination of those errors, potentially sending multiple error reports.
annotation.justification: The use of "any one" could be interpreted as a single error, or as any subset of errors. The clause does not clarify if multiple error reports are allowed, creating ambiguity in implementation.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify whether the endpoint is limited to reporting a single error, or if it can report multiple errors. This affects how an endpoint handles concurrent errors and how the receiving end interprets the error condition.
